subject: Temporary relay proxy addition — clarifications & DPA appendix request
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@northbridge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary relay proxy for EU edge — request and info packet

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As discussed, NorthBridge would like to be added as a temporary relay/CDN partner for a small subset of EU customer traffic while our rollout of the new EU POPs finishes. This would be a transit-only relay (no long-term storage) and only for defined routes in eu-west-1 for a 6–8 week window.

What I’m attaching: a short dataflow diagram (northbridge-prod-dataflow.pdf) and our SOC2 summary (northbridge-soc2-summary.pdf). High-level notes:
- TLS in flight (TLS1.2+), SNI-restricted routing.
- No data persists longer than 72 hours on the relay nodes; logs stored for 30 days and rotated.
- We can sign a DPA addendum limiting residency to eu-west-1 and restricting support access.

Could you confirm the following for Redwood operations/legal:
1) Is a DPA appendix the correct vehicle for this temporary change?
2) Any additional evidence you need besides SOC2 and the flow diagram?
3) Is there a required sign-off process (security, privacy, legal) we should follow to avoid blocking the canary?

We’re happy to join a short review meeting and provide more detailed encryption attestation if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations — NorthBridge Technologies
alex.johnson@northbridge.io
Attachments: northbridge-prod-dataflow.pdf (diagram), northbridge-soc2-summary.pdf (summary)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@northbridge.io>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Temporary relay proxy for EU edge — request and info packet

Kimberly / Markus / Laura — looping you in to review NorthBridge's temporary relay request (attached diagrams from Alex). Quick checklist items I need answered so I can respond and unblock their canary deploy:
- Legal/privacy: is a DPA addendum sufficient for a short-lived relay that only holds logs for 30 days? Any mandatory clauses we require (e.g., export control, subprocessor-specific termination language)?
- Security/Infra: confirm requirement list — e.g., customer KMS keys must not be shared, TLS peer cert pinning, support access limited to IP allowlist, geofence egress to eu-west-1.
- Compliance: do we require SOC2 type II evidence or would their summary + current report be adequate?

Proposed approach: if legal/privacy get a quick green (with a DPA appendix and an IP-restricted support clause), infra can do a canary for 1% of EU traffic for 48 hours, with immediate rollback on any error or increased latency.

Alex — thanks for the packet. Please confirm you can agree to an appendix limiting processing to eu-west-1 and for DocuSign for an addendum. If so, Kimberly can draft language.

Irene
Irene Choi
Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@northbridge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Temporary relay proxy for EU edge — request and info packet

Thanks, Irene. Quick answers below and a link to our DPA supplement in case that speeds things up: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSharedFolder

- DPA appendix: yes, we accept an addendum that limits processing to eu-west-1 and includes a termination clause at 7 days notice for temporary relays.
- Logs: retained 30 days, encrypted at rest with AES-256. We rotate keys and can provide a KMS attestation; we do not have access to customer plaintext.
- Support access: restricted via IP allowlist + jumpbox audit; we’ll provide the IP list and PKI thumbprints.
- Evidence: our SOC2 summary is attached; we can provide the full Type II report under NDA if you need it.

We are ready to sign the DPA addendum via DocuSign once you send it. We can also stand up a demo canary and share telemetry for the first 24 hours.

Let me know next steps; happy to join a 30-min call with security/privacy/legal to walk the flow.

— Alex
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@northbridge.io>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Temporary relay proxy for EU edge — request and info packet

Alex / Irene — thanks for the detail and for confirming the residency and controls. From a legal/privacy perspective we can provisionally approve the temporary relay subject to:
1) Signed DPA addendum that includes: processing limitation to eu-west-1, 7-day termination notice, support access only by named NorthBridge engineers and IP allowlist, and an obligation to notify Redwood within 24 hours of any security incident.
2) NorthBridge to provide either the full SOC2 Type II report under NDA or a SOC2 auditor letter scoped to the relay.
3) A short operational runbook for the canary (rollback criteria, telemetry endpoints, contact points).

If you agree to the above, we will prepare a DocuSign package for the addendum and Kimberly will be the signing contact on our side. Please send the IP allowlist and the KMS attestation document; once we’ve executed the addendum infra will schedule a 1% canary in eu-west-1 for 48 hours.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
